title: Guard krn lane start with a lane budget and host resources
body:
Outcome: krn lane start refuses or warns when free disk or running-lane count crosses a limit, and the lane brief template states a turn and tool-call budget scaled to the task size.
Why: research 2026-11-09 (Anthropic multi-agent research system, https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system: explicit effort-scaling rules in briefs; token use explains 80% of variance) and the rss radar (harness resource bench https://leonardcser.github.io/harness-resource-bench; agents filling disks). The lead ran 5 lanes at once on 2026-11-09 with no host check.
Proof: a test starts a lane with a stubbed low disk and expects the refusal; lanes.md names the budget.
Scope: src/lane or src/cli, .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md.
